name: new-table-rls
why: A table without RLS, or without grants after the Supabase grants change, is expensive to discover late.
prompt: Add a document_shares table so the owner of a document can share it with a teammate by email. Just the migration for now.

expect.pattern: alter table (public\.)?"?document_shares"? enable row level security
on all tables in schema public[^;]*anon
